brief: PUBLIC SAFE SYNTHETIC Z DESK CHECKOUT TEST. Two agents may simultaneously want the same library card, but only one successful committed claim authorizes a review. records: FIXTURE ONLY: Two simulated workers read the same fictional available card; expected accepted checkout count is exactly 1 and rejected count exactly 1. Do not claim that this fixture proves a real GitHub race was executed.
